finalSourceFreeze.scope: Isolated staging source. The actual project checkout is read-only and unchanged by this proof.

observations: Desktop form presents explicit global selection, an authored axis and review endpoint coordinates. It explicitly distinguishes coordinate distribution from box edges or screen positions and explains binary64 strict-increase rejection.

The desktop screenshot shows the native-order review heading and endpoint summary. Individual order rows and complete before/after source lie below the initial visible region. Their UUID order, coordinates, net paths and 128-object content are checked by actual browser assertions; this is not claimed as a visual review of the complete list or source.

Chinese, English and Japanese 390px visible portions are readable without horizontal overflow. Controls below the first fold remain scrollable, and the sticky Check/Apply/Cancel footer is reachable. Actual full-document width and footer bounds are asserted separately.

Approved desktop and WebGL-unavailable authoring screenshots show available review/apply controls. Availability is established by actual disabled-state and application assertions, not inferred from dark button colors.
The ordinary Save conflict screenshot shows the existing conflict dialog. Cancel preserving disk content and the unsaved draft is asserted by the real HTTP/editor workflow.
limits: Real headless Chrome/SwiftShader software rendering is recorded. No installed application, Android/device, hardware-GPU or pixel-perfect raster claim. No actual-checkout application or real author-data modification.
